errors.text: The material family is misidentified: the target is as-cast eutectic AlCoCrFeNi2.1 with FCC and B2 phases, not an Al-Hf-Nb-Ti-V refractory HEA with a B2 matrix and FCC precipitates.
The proposed 600–800 K aging range is far below the target 550–750 °C window and therefore does not reconstruct the relevant ordering and phase-boundary evolution.
Chemical ordering is assigned primarily to B2, whereas the target mediator is enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains approaching Ni3Al stoichiometry.

The proposed recovery through B2 martensitic transformation or a metastable lower-order B2 state is not supported as an aging-recovery mechanism by the cited evidence and conflicts with the target mechanism of reduced L12 ordering and ductile phase-boundary transition zones.
The cited studies concern different alloy systems and do not establish a ductile-brittle-ductile aging transition in the proposed refractory alloy.
